verdict.rationale: A payments platform could plausibly offer user-configured background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no such feature. Recurring stablecoin subscriptions (private preview) are a billing feature, not general automations. Machine payments, webhooks, the MCP server and the sandbox are agent or developer building blocks, not a first-party automation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
